about:
Georgia public school calendars are approved locally by each school district, so first day of school, last day, holidays, teacher planning days, digital learning days, and break schedules can vary across the state. Large metro Atlanta districts often publish multi-year calendars so families can compare school-year dates before planning childcare, travel, and activities.

MySchoolDates currently includes Georgia district calendar pages with official source links, printable PDF references, key dates, and calendar download options when available. Families should still check the official district calendar for school-specific events, testing schedules, graduation dates, athletic calendars, and weather-related updates.
planningTips: Georgia districts may schedule fall break, winter break, spring break, teacher planning days, and digital learning days differently, even within the same metro area.
Check the official district calendar before booking travel near fall break, spring break, or the end of the school year.
Metro Atlanta families comparing multiple districts should verify each district separately because break weeks may not align.
Use school websites for graduation, testing, athletics, and campus events that may not appear on the districtwide academic calendar.

faqs.a: Georgia school start dates vary by district. Many large districts begin in early or mid-August, but families should select their district calendar to confirm the official first day of school.

faqs.q: Are Georgia school calendars the same statewide?
faqs.a: No. Georgia public school calendars are approved locally, so first day, last day, breaks, teacher planning days, and digital learning days can differ by district.

faqs.q: Do Georgia districts publish multi-year calendars?
faqs.a: Some Georgia districts publish calendars for current and future school years. Availability varies by district, so check the district page and official source links for the years currently available.

faqs.q: Can I add a Georgia school calendar to Google Calendar?
faqs.a: Yes. District pages on MySchoolDates include calendar download options when available, including ICS files that can be imported into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.
